adm.changelogHint: Every field-level change, with actor, reason, source and transaction id.

adm.configPendingHint: Nothing is written until you save.
adm.configResetAllBody: Every override in this instance will be dropped and the shipped defaults will apply again. The change is audited.

adm.formModeAutoHint: A dialog when the window is at least 960 px wide, a full page on a phone or a split screen.
adm.formModeDialogHint: The form opens over the list or dossier, which stays visible behind it.
adm.formModeInstanceDefault: Set the instance default to dialog for everyone
adm.formModeInstanceHint: Saved in the database and served to every client; each person may override it for themselves.
adm.formModeIntro: Adding, editing and every other data-entry surface can appear as a focused dialog over the page you came from, or as a full page. It is one preference; the buttons, shortcuts and validation behave identically either way.
adm.formModeOverridingInstance: Your own choice, overriding the instance default ({value}).
adm.formModePageHint: The form replaces the screen. Best for long records and for people who read every field.
adm.formModeTryHint: Opens a real new-record form in the chosen surface, without saving anything.
adm.localesHint: Add a locale row and a JSON bundle in static/js/locales to introduce a new interface language.
adm.numberingHint: Identification numbers are generated from these rules; existing codes are never rewritten.
adm.purgeConfirm: {files} abandoned file(s), {mb} MB, can be removed. Files still referenced by a record are never touched. Continue?
adm.purgeHint: Removes abandoned import staging files and uploaded files no record points at
adm.settingsHint: Application-wide preferences stored in the database.
adm.usersHint: The acting user is sent as X-Actor by the interface; put the app behind an authenticating proxy before exposing it publicly.
adm.vocabHint: Every controlled list in the registry. System values can be deactivated but never deleted.

geo.pickOnMap: Click the map to set the point. Drag the marker to adjust it.
geo.coordsHint: Decimal degrees, degrees-minutes-seconds, hemisphere letters before or after the numbers, Arabic-Indic digits — all accepted.
geo.coordsLabel: Type a coordinate in any common notation
geo.districtHint: Districts recorded for the selected governorate.
geo.districtNeedCountry: Select a country and governorate first to list districts.
geo.crsHint: Click to switch the readout between geographic and projected coordinates.
geo.invalidCoord: That is not a coordinate we can read.
geo.libraryMissing: The map library did not load. The rest of the application is unaffected.

geo.tempHint: This position is temporary. It is not stored, and it is discarded as soon as you select a record.

ui.noFiltersYetAddOneFromTheRecordSOwnFi: No filters yet. Add one from the record's own fields or from related tables (relationship count, institution name, completeness…).

ui.rendersAnIllustratedCardWhenAUrlIsPre: Renders an illustrated card when a URL is present.
ui.searchForTheSourceOrCreateANewOneStra: Search for the source, or create a new one straight from the list without leaving the page.

ui.theseValuesAreNeverStoredOrEditedThey: These values are never stored or edited; they are computed at read time from linked relationships, positions, citations and vocabularies, and are valid for sorting, filtering, export and reports.
